entities.name: Agnaptus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Agnaptus was an ancient Greek architect mentioned by Pausanias as the builder of a stoa, or porch, in the Altis at Olympia, which was called by the Eleans the "porch of Agnaptus". When he lived is uncertain.
